tasks.short: Observe yard traffic and assess available tracks

steps.what: Observe yard traffic and determine tracks available under current conditions

tasks.design: Keep direct observation and current track assessment with the yardmaster. An existing {OPS_SYSTEM} display may inform that assessment, but no reduction in observation time is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: An occupancy display alone does not establish whether a track can accept a particular movement.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automation is proposed for this observation task.
tasks.still_hard: Conditions can change while vehicles and people move through the yard.
tasks.human_edge: Relate visible movements, restrictions and uncertainty to the immediate situation.
tasks.altitude: Observation duties and movement decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Confirm the location of a proposed movement
reach.learn: Local track layout and communication protocol

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct observation and operational assessment remain human work; no local time saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is observation and assessment, excluding dispatch authorisation and physical movement.

The yardmaster produces the current track assessment during s1; no structured available-track flag is assumed. Unclear conditions require further observation and established communication, all retained in s1.
Test existing native display configuration before considering custom tools; no configuration change is proposed here.
Incremental upkeep is zero because the existing observation process and equipment are unchanged.
unknowns: Yard visibility and existing occupancy displays
research_questions: Does a display actually remove any observation work without weakening current-condition checks?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and incremental=0, net=0. Both an unobstructed yard and a yard requiring repeated observation retain all assessment time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Receive instructions from dispatchers and clarify routes, timetables and cargoes

tasks.design: Receive and clarify instructions through the established {TELEPHONY} channel. Keep the conductor's attention, readback and discrepancy resolution in the task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Delivery of a message does not establish correct understanding of its operational meaning.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication equipment already conveys the instructions.
tasks.still_hard: Revised instructions and misunderstood locations need immediate clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Detect ambiguity and challenge a conflicting instruction.
tasks.altitude: The conductor retains the same instruction-receipt responsibilities.

reach.task: Clarify a route instruction before movement

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: communication delivery and operational understanding are different activities; this design retains the latter in full.

assumptions: Boundary starts with receiving an instruction; dispatcher planning and issue authority remain outside and unchanged.

The dispatcher produces route, train identity, timetable changes, cargo restrictions and instruction revision before receipt. The conductor captures and confirms the relevant content within s1; missing or conflicting information returns to the dispatcher within the retained conversation. No free structured instruction export is assumed.
Check native communication facilities before custom integration; no new integration is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep follows from leaving the existing process unchanged; existing equipment runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Instruction channels and mandatory confirmation procedure
research_questions: What portion of receipt is actual clarification rather than avoidable transcription?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving are 0 with no incremental upkeep. Clear and revised instructions both retain human receipt and confirmation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Direct workers switching tracks, coupling cars and routing yard traffic

tasks.design: Keep live yard direction and crew confirmation with the yardmaster using {TELEPHONY}. Existing operational records support the conversation without generating movement commands.
tasks.previous_blocker: A planned movement cannot account for every changing local condition or crew response.
tasks.enabler_now: No new command automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinate interdependent movements and stop when conditions differ from the plan.
tasks.human_edge: Make and communicate a safe immediate decision within existing authority.
tasks.altitude: Direction duties and authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Confirm completion of a requested switch action
reach.learn: Local movement limits and confirmation protocol

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: directing current yard movements involves live coordination; no labour saving is claimed from a scheduling capability.

assumptions: Boundary covers issuing and clarifying directions, excluding the crew's physical switching and coupling work.

The yardmaster obtains the current assessment and applicable authority before each instruction; observation belongs to task 10702 and is counted once in a roll-up. Crew members produce acknowledgements and changed-condition reports during s1 before the next direction. No machine-readable clear-to-move flag is assumed; uncertainty prompts human clarification within retained time.
Use existing native communication features before custom tools; this design adds none.
Incremental upkeep is zero because there is no new automation or transferred duty.
unknowns: Local authority chain and communication procedure
research_questions: Which coordination delays reflect missing physical confirmation rather than removable clerical work?

already_counted.description: Assessing each direction, confirming its exact content and handling crew responses

approvals.approved_version: Exact crew, vehicles, track, direction, movement limit and current-condition snapshot confirmed immediately before each instruction; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; gross=net=0. Routine and disrupted switching retain the full live coordination share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Signal engineers to begin runs, stop trains or change speed

tasks.design: Keep the conductor's live signalling and response checks. Where {TELEPHONY} replaces hand signals, the same human judgement and communication time remains.
tasks.previous_blocker: A signal depends on immediate conditions and applicable movement authority.
tasks.enabler_now: No change to the signalling process is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Respond promptly when visibility, acknowledgement or conditions are uncertain.
tasks.human_edge: Issue the appropriate signal and recognise when the movement must stop.
tasks.altitude: Signalling responsibility remains with the qualified person.

reach.task: Confirm the meaning of a movement signal

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: generating a movement signal from live conditions is distinct from compiling a report; no automation saving is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is the conductor's signalling and confirmation, excluding train operation and dispatcher planning.

The conductor checks current conditions and authority within s1 before each signal. The engineer produces acknowledgement during the exchange before its completion. No ready-made safe-to-signal flag is assumed; unclear conditions retain manual stopping and clarification time.
Check existing native communication arrangements before custom software; no change is proposed.
Incremental upkeep is zero because the existing signalling procedure remains in place. Yard direction and signalling for the same action must have one owner in a team roll-up.
research_questions: Is there any separable clerical activity inside the observed signalling task?

already_counted.description: Current-condition checks, signal approval and acknowledgement

approvals.approved_version: Exact train, engineer, signal meaning, location, movement limit and current-condition snapshot confirmed before issue; a changed condition voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=0 and net=0 after zero incremental upkeep. Both routine starts and urgent stops retain human signalling time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Live observation, instruction receipt, coordination and signalling remain human responsibilities.
reach: Improve mutual confirmation with locomotive engineers and switch operators within existing qualifications.
role.ambitious_version: The same operational role with clear ownership of each live instruction and signal.
